item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 19/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southwesterly airstream will bring a few showers to the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. Besides, under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, there will be sunny periods and it will be very hot during the day over the coast of southern China midweek this week. A trough of low pressure is expected to affect southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week.

Date/Month: 19/06 (Monday)
Wind: South to southwest force 4 to 5.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Showers will be heavier in some areas with thunderstorms at first. Sunny intervals in the afternoon.
Temp range: 27 - 31 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
